source_observation: rewriteErasures checks maxObjects only before a day, processes every listed object in that day, and persists done_through/counters only after the full day. A dense day exceeds the declared cap and interruption repeats already-mutated work with counters not durably attributable.
reproduction_basis: Source-confirmed by two independent Astra/xhigh reads and existing F06 R4/R5 reports (48 opens with cap5 and lost progress after interruption). New grouped assertions use the existing erasure fixture; no broad baseline suite.
limits: No concurrent cross-store fence, shopper revocation, other-destination reconciliation, approved retention/physical SLA, deployed/customer or release acceptance.
